node.label: Absent glenoid fossa
node.definition: Lack of development of the glenoid fossa, also known as the glenoid cavity, which is the articular surface of the scapula that articulates with the head of the humerus.

evidence.snippet: Kagami-Ogata syndrome due to paternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 14: Absent glenoid fossa (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
